searchText: are we good with https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/546 ? L2s are fine with it although some would prefer just filtering by versioned hashes but there is too much pushback from clients (and even L2s) to drop block index Could one request specific columns of given blob? lets say we wanna use this beacon api endpoint for checkpoint sync, and wanna get only 4 columns for non validating nodes instead of all 128 columns not with this api as it's purpose is to serve blobs for L2s (mostly), but `/eth/v1/debug/beacon/data_column_sidecars/{block_id}` allows to pass `indices` (of columns) so that should do it
